name: Mishima Yuzuha
source:
She is the daughter of the “school cafeteria lady” who looked after Touya and Renny when they were students, and she is the same age as Kanata.

As a child, she referred to herself using the masculine-like pronoun “boku” and was the kind of kid who would run around waving a stick; Touya and the others only know her from that time.

However, her un-girly behavior led to her being bullied at school, and she ended up becoming a shy girl.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150903004157/http://www.sp-janis.com/janis/candytoys]official site and slightly modified[/url]]
